e5_preregistration.primary_metric: gain-controlled masked delta SDR (dB) on true clip mask, delay_samples=0, single shared whole-track stereo scalar gain, eps=1e-20, all-input accounting (failures and abstentions = 0.0 dB)
e5_preregistration.cluster_unit: independent recording cluster (take/artist); multiple slices collapsed first
e5_preregistration.ci_method: 95% paired cluster bootstrap (10000 resamples, seed=20261123) + Student-t 95% CI
e5_preregistration.multiplicity_correction: Holm-Bonferroni step-down across the 3 pre-planned confirmatory comparisons

locked_hypotheses.rule: 95% cluster CI lower bound > +1.0 dB (gate_margin_sdr_db) AND Holm-Bonferroni p < 0.05
95% cluster CI lower bound > 0.0 dB AND Holm-Bonferroni p < 0.05
95% cluster CI lower bound >= -0.50 dB (-gate_margin_vs_external_db) with verified faster or equal local CPU wall_s_per_audio_min p95 and zero stereo safety rubric violations

blind_listening_panel_protocol.loudness_matching: equal achievable loudness verified <= 0.2 LU after FLAC encode (scripts/listen_pack.py)
blind_listening_panel_protocol.design: double-blind A/B preference + artifact check (BS.1116 reference anchor), randomized blind IDs, custodian-held key, balanced AB/BA order with hidden repeats
blind_listening_panel_protocol.cluster_ci: 95% CI accounting for both recording cluster and listener cluster
blind_listening_panel_protocol.promotion_requirement: positive perceptual preference claim confirmed with no significant listening harm; insufficient power or inconclusive -> no-promote/inconclusive

e5_preregistration.immutability_rule: Any parameter, detector, solver, or threshold edit after this freeze invalidates this preregistration and requires a new sealed corpus version.
